name: presentation-tools
description: Presentation skills for routing, creating, reviewing, and exporting Slidev, PPTX, and LaTeX Beamer decks.

interface.shortDescription: Slidev, PPTX, and LaTeX presentation helpers.

defaultPrompt: Create a presentation and choose the right output format.
Build this deck using the supplied PowerPoint template.
Turn these notes into a Beamer or Slidev technical talk.
